about: Every Europe PMC response the tests read, where it came from and under what licence. A recorded response comes only from a paper under CC BY or CC0, cut to its funding sections, with every name replaced (docs/constraints/personal-data.md). The names listed are the made-up ones the fixtures carry, which the tests check never reach the table, the logs or the page.
